content.summary: Accept this exact version within the stated local formal-assurance scope. Fresh inspection confirms the advertised support and equivalence hypotheses, and the final rendered small-L argument preserves its meaning. Snapshot, manuscript, inspected sources, and rendering hashes match. No required revision or unresolved major logic finding remains in this final run.

checks.scope: Final support-53 scope and implication strength
checks.method: Read the final manuscript, literal_support53, SupportFinish53 interface, and both Fin 53 equivalence directions afresh; verified source-manifest hashes.
checks.observation: The support theorem accepts Type u without ambient finiteness and bounds the actual union of exactly 28 distinct four-sets. Reflexive intersection and empty-core sunflower exclusion are retained. The subsequent reduction selects 28 members before applying this bound; it does not assert support at most 53 for an arbitrary larger family. The named Type-level I(27) equivalence and universe-polymorphic counterexample reduction remain correctly distinguished. Neither implication independently establishes finite nonexistence.

checks.method: Matched F35 to the final manuscript hash, checked HTML code spans, and visually inspected final PDF pages 4–5.
checks.observation: The branches L=0,1,2 versus L≥3 and 0≤L≤5 versus L≥6 remain readable and exhaustive. Multiplication signs, subtraction, and inequalities survive rendering. Nonnegativity handles small L, monotonicity handles the larger ranges, and thresholds 2262 and 4488 remain unchanged.
